title: Fix /memories/context bespoke scorer bypassing suppressions, lived_log_memory same-tick drop, and unwired daily_reflection unit mismatch

sections.what: Align backend memory paths: delegate `/memories/context` recall to read-only associative retrieval so suppressed/invalidated memories aren't leaked, fix same-tick event dropping in `lived_log_memory.bridge()`, and fix/wire `daily_reflection.py` timestamp unit and entity_ids.
sections.why: Three backend cognition consistency bugs: (1) routes/memories.py lines 1171-1197 implements a 4th standalone recall scorer that ignores `suppressions` and `invalid_at`; (2) engine/lived_log_memory.py lines 104-107 skips `if tick <= mark: continue` and advances `lived_log_memorized_through = newest`, silently dropping any additional memorizable event written later on the same tick after an earlier bridge() call; (3) engine/daily_reflection.py `maybe_reflect()` has zero runtime callers outside tests, stores `total_game_minutes` into `timestamp` (line 90, mixing units with `time.time()`), and leaves `entity_ids: []` empty.
sections.how:
1. Replace the bespoke inline keyword/recency loop in routes/memories.py get_memory_context (lines 1171-1197) with a read-only call to `memory_retrieval.retrieve_associative_memories(..., do_reinforce=False, explain=True)` so Memory Weaver previews obey `suppressions`, `invalid_at`, `superseded_by`, and associative scoring parity.
2. Fix `lived_log_memory.bridge()` (engine/lived_log_memory.py lines 101-131) to track a per-tick index / monotonic entry offset or entry ID set alongside `lived_log_memorized_through` so calling `bridge()` mid-tick does not drop subsequent entries added later during the same tick.
3. Audit `engine/daily_reflection.py` (lines 84-103, 136-172): fix `timestamp` to use canonical Unix epoch `time.time()` (not `total_game_minutes`), populate `entity_ids` via matching/derived participants, and wire `maybe_reflect` into `background_simulation.py` / `tick_manager.py` when a local/background reflection provider is enabled (or explicitly retire per `task-409` / `task-688` open question).
sections.verify: 1. Run pytest tests asserting `/memories/context` excludes suppressed and invalidated memories via memory_retrieval, `lived_log_memory.bridge()` preserves multiple events written on the same tick across repeated calls, and `daily_reflection` writes valid Unix timestamps and resolved entity_ids cleanly when invoked in simulation.

acceptance.text: POST /api/players/<name>/memories/context delegates recall to memory_retrieval.retrieve_associative_memories(..., explain=True, do_reinforce=False) and honors suppressions, invalid_at, and superseded_by consistently with /memories/retrieve.

lived_log_memory.bridge tracks processed entries cleanly within a single tick (entry watermark / recorded IDs or index cursor) instead of dropping later same-tick events via `if tick <= mark: continue`.

daily_reflection.py uses consistent Unix epoch timestamp vs world game_minutes fields, resolves entity_ids on written reflections, and is either wired into background simulation / tick_manager (under its config/provider guard) or formally retired in favor of Reflection 2.0.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Memory Weaver & Editor context bundle (`POST /api/players/<name>/memories/context` -> recalled memories preview) and Character Inspector -> Mind -> Memories list.

Current availability: /memories/context uses a separate inline keyword+recency loop that skips suppressions/invalid_at; lived_log_memory.bridge drops additional events logged on the same tick after an earlier bridge() call; daily_reflection.py is unused in runtime and writes total_game_minutes into epoch timestamp.

Manual verification steps:
1. Suppress or invalidate a memory on a character, then open Memory Weaver -> preview recalled context (`/memories/context`).
   - expected: Suppressed and invalidated memories never appear in `recalled_memories`.
2. Record two memorizable lived_log events on tick T with a bridge() call between them.
   - expected: Both events produce memories instead of the second event being skipped by `tick <= mark`.
3. Trigger background daily reflection (or verify configured provider hook) and inspect stored memory timestamps and entity_ids.
   - expected: Reflections wire cleanly, timestamps match canonical schema units, and mentioned entities populate entity_ids.
